Practised multiplying by 10 and 100 using place value.
Sameer correctly calculated 10 × 10, 25 × 10, 36 × 10, 7 × 100, and 125 × 100.
Practised estimating by rounding; the “round both numbers” instruction needed clarification.
Practised doubling and halving for 25 × 16; Sameer doubled both factors instead of doubling one and halving the other.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Sameer practised placing zeros when multiplying by 10 and 100, and this method was used correctly in several examples. They also worked on the doubling-and-halving method, but mixed up which factor to double and which to halve; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, try a few examples such as 25 × 16 and say aloud: “double one factor, halve the other,” checking that the product stays unchanged.
